correctness.rationale: The Euler factor formula is a direct unitary-divisor identity. For p>=29 the Nagura bound p_next<6p/5 implies p_next^3<2p^3. Algebra proves that the truncated criterion factor F_i increases strictly to zeta(3)/zeta(6), so the complete tail for primes >=31 is an interval [1,T], not a finite experiment. The other ten primes are handled by a finite exhaustive exponent-class merger; exact zeta enclosures and rational inequalities certify 14 disjoint intervals with the claimed endpoints.
